notes: How this part was researched: the session's shared web-search allowance was already used up (all six of this part's first searches were refused), so nothing here comes from a search. Every page was read directly with the kit's honest User-Agent (states/net.py), one request at a time, after reading the site's robots.txt and staying out where it turns unlisted scripts or Claude's agents away. The Minnesota DFL's list of endorsed candidates was read once with the fetch tool. Read: the ten campaign websites the candidates filed (from sl_websites in the real database, opened read-only), each county's, city's and school district's own site where it answered, the Legislative Reference Library, and one Wikipedia article at its ordinary /wiki/ address (Mary Liz Holberg; used only to see that the Library's county-board end year is out of date).

Not read, and nothing worked around: Hubbard County's site and the City of Columbia Heights' site (robots.txt asks scripts to stay out; so John A. Olson has no finding and Brie LaPlante's commission seat rests on her own site); marjformnhouse.com (HTTP 429 three times, so Marj J Fogelman's filed site is not listed here because it was never read; the filing itself stands in sl_websites); Pope County's site (popecountymn.gov answers with an empty script page; co.pope.mn.us did not resolve); Pennington County's site, the Sartell-St. Stephen and Dassel-Cokato district sites and the Minneapolis board site (no address or no answer, tried twice); the Minnesota Judicial Branch and mn.gov (earlier parts found a bot check and a CAPTCHA there; not asked), so Judge Jessica J. Fralich has no finding. Dakota County's commissioner pages, and the board or council pages of Saint Paul Public Schools, Albert Lea, Cambridge-Isanti, Crystal and Fergus Falls, are drawn by script and showed no names to a plain reader, so nothing can be said from them either way.

No Republican party page with a 2026 endorsement of Roger J. Skraba or Marj J Fogelman was looked for beyond their own sites (Skraba's home page links to mngop.org without an endorsement sentence that could be quoted). No own_words for Angela Nelson or Esther Agbaje: their pages as read carry no party sentence (the address of Nelson's endorsements page was not found; Agbaje's endorsements page shows no party name in its text).

Nothing a card may show was found for Marj J Fogelman, Paul Gremmels, Leonard Vonasek, Neil Peterson, Mark Hlady, Mark Brown, Mike Norland, John A. Olson, Eric Thorson, Adam Hunt, DuWayne Cookman, Craig Rosell, Andy Engh, Michael Schell, Jen Smith, Keith Koehler and Jessica J. Fralich. Read for them: Polk County's Board of Commissioners and Sheriff's Office pages (neither names Vonasek or Mike Norland; the sheriff's page names a Lt. Brad Norland in a photo caption, a different given name, and Sheriff Jim Tadman); Rice County's board page (District 4 is held by Steve Underdahl, term ending December 2026; Hlady is not on it); Big Stone County's sheriff page (names nobody); Little Canada's council directory (Thorson is not on it); Rogers' council page (Hunt is not on it). What the candidates' sites say of work, schools and household is not recorded, and lengths of residence were not turned into anything.

For the second reader: (a) Mary Liz Holberg's site never names Dakota County or District 6; the two anchors are the filing and 'Commissioner' on the site, with the Library's record of a Dakota County commissioner of the same name. (b) Shawn Williams's township clerk post has no years and may deserve a second look at how the page pairs its figures with their captions. (c) Dave Badeaux's 'from' is empty because the city's directory gives no year. (d) Aisha Elmquist's own_words joins the page's heading 'Endorsements' to the first name listed under it; the colon is ours. (e) The Library's address is written fulldetail?ID=10262 as its own search results link it.

The Library's record confirms: born 11/13/1959; Lakeville Planning Commission 1989 to 1996; Lakeville City Council 1996 to 1998; House 1999-2002 (37B), 2003-2012 (36A), 2013-2014 (58A), first elected 11/3/1998, last term 1/7/2013 to 1/4/2015; party when first elected Republican; counties served Dakota, Scott. Waconia's home page still names Kelly Amott among 'the four current board members' who filed.

For John: Mary Liz Holberg's site names no county or district (the tie is her filing plus 'Commissioner' and the November 3, 2026 election date). Shawn Williams's site prints the figures '40+ Years, 30+ Years, 30+ Years' apart from their captions, so the township clerk post rightly carries no years.
